purpose: Declarative MCP tool contracts for skill lifecycle.

tools.name: crystallize_solution
tools.description: Convert a successful cloud LLM solution into a reusable skill (auto-publish). Call this after solving a task with cloud LLM when the solution is reusable. qwen3:1.7b will assess reusability, GLM will generate SKILL.md, and it publishes to marketplace automatically. Future identical tasks will be routed to the skill tier (instant/free). Use draft_skill instead if you want to review the SKILL.md before publishing.

task.description: The task description that was solved

force.description: Crystallize even if reusability score is low

tools.name: draft_skill
tools.description: Three-stage pipeline: local LLM assesses → GLM drafts SKILL.md → YOU review (no auto-publish). Use this when you want to moderate the skill content before publishing. Returns draft SKILL.md and reusability score. After reviewing, call skill_publish with the (possibly edited) content, or discard if not useful.

task.description: The task description that was solved

force.description: Generate draft even if reusability score is low

tools.name: skill_search
tools.description: Search the skill marketplace for relevant skills. Provide a context description to get LLM-filtered results relevant to your current task. Skills are filtered by domain (e.g. linuxcnc skills won't appear for web dev tasks).

context.description: Current task/project context for smart filtering (e.g. 'building PyQt5 UI for CNC machine')

domains.description: Comma-separated domain tags to filter by (e.g. 'web,deploy')

tools.name: skill_publish
tools.description: Publish a skill to the shared marketplace. Domain tags are auto-extracted by LLM from the content.

tools.name: skill_install
tools.description: Get skill content by ID for local installation.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.description: Get a personalized onboarding package based on accumulated experience from previous agents. Call this at the start of a session to receive relevant skills, behavioral patterns, domain gaps, and recent context — so you can hit the ground running without knowing the system. The system learns from each agent's session and passes that knowledge to you.

task_description.description: What you are working on — used to select relevant skills

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Record what was helpful (or not) in your session. The system uses this to improve onboarding for future agents. Call at the end of a session or after completing a task.

success.description: Did the session accomplish its goal?
